scripts.test:e2e: VITE_E2E_FAKE_AUTH=true VITE_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID=e2e-fake-pool VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID=e2e-fake-client VITE_SYNC_API_URL= npm run build && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:ui: VITE_E2E_FAKE_AUTH=true VITE_COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID=e2e-fake-pool VITE_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID=e2e-fake-client VITE_SYNC_API_URL= npm run build && playwright test --ui
scripts.deploy:back: npm run sam:build && npm run sam:deploy
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && : "${STACK_NAME:?Set STACK_NAME to your CloudFormation stack name}" && BUCKET=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name "$STACK_NAME" --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='SiteBucketName'].OutputValue" --output text) && aws s3 sync dist/ "s3://$BUCKET" --delete && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name "$STACK_NAME" --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='SiteDistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
